content:
alex: quick idea — I made a small prototype for a `runbook-snippet` generator the deploy bot can append to release notes. want to test during next change window?

maria: curious — what does the snippet include by default? rollback steps, rollout flags, etc?

alex: minimal for now: summary, canary plan, quick rollback commands, pin instructions, and contact oncall. example: 
```
Summary: deploy service X v2.4.1 -> v2.5.0
Canary: 5% traffic for 10m, check errors/latency
Rollback: /deploy rollback --tag v2.4.1 --reason "canary regressions"
Pin: /deploy pin --service service-x --version v2.5.0
Contact: @oncall (pager)
```

jordan: I'm down to try. can the bot detect which services need DB migrations and add a migration note?

alex: yes — proto detects release manifest and injects a "migrations" block when it sees migration: true. it's heuristic for now.

sam: what about change windows + whitelist? we need the snippet to include the change-window ID and exempt list.

alex: good call. plan to have flags: `--change-window-id` and `--exempt-teams`. bot will expand templates like: 
```
Change window: cw-2026-06-10-22
Exempt teams: payments, analytics
```

maria: also add a short telemetry checklist: smoke endpoint, p95, error budget check. a one-liner with links would be ideal.

alex: will add telemetry checklist and a `/deploy runbook-verify` hook that runs smoke + p95 queries and returns pass/fail. will stub it for the pilot.

deploy-bot: generated runbook snippet (draft) for `service-x`: 
```
SUMMARY: Rolling service-x to v2.5.0 (image sha: sha256:aaa111)
CANARY: %5 traffic -> 10m; metrics to watch: error_rate, p95_latency
MIGRATIONS: none detected
ROLLBACK: /deploy rollback --service service-x --tag v2.4.1
PIN: /deploy pin --service service-x --version v2.5.0
CHANGE_WINDOW: cw-2026-06-10-22
EXEMPT_TEAMS: payments
CHECKS: smoke /health, p95 query (last 10m) -> /dash/quicklink
CONTACTS: @oncall, @infra
```

jordan: looks solid. couple of suggestions: make rollback command safe by default (prompt or dry-run); and include an escape hatch note for region fallback.

alex: agree. will have `--dry-run` default unless `--force`. region fallback section will list alternate regions and a /deploy failover command.

sam: can the bot append this snippet to the release notes automatically when a PR is merged with a release label? that'd save manual copy/paste.

alex: yep — two modes: `append-on-merge` or `suggest` (post a comment with snippet to check). for pilot we'll use `suggest` so humans validate.

maria: one more: include a small template for post-release verification (what to check after 30m) and a place to paste quick incident links.

alex: yep — post-release checklist included in draft.

jordan: how do we test this without hitting prod? can we simulate with `--dry-run --env staging`?

alex: exactly. `deploy-bot` accepts `--env staging` and will generate a staging snippet and a mock CI job that runs the checks.

deploy-bot: note — to try the generator in staging run: `/deploy runbook-gen --service service-x --version v2.5.0 --env staging --mode suggest`

sam: nice. tl;dr for change window reviewers: we should surface a one-line summary at the top so reviewers don't have to read the whole snippet. maybe `TL;DR: canary 5% 10m, rollback cmd included`.

alex: done — top-line TL;DR added. i'll convert prototype into a small CLI subcommand and a bot command. aiming to demo in the release ops sync tomorrow.

maria: I'll review the draft and test smoke queries. will post feedback by EOD. :thumbsup:

jordan: I'll try the staging flow after lunch.

alex: thanks — leaving a checklist here: 
- [ ] add dry-run default & --force override
- [ ] region fallback template
- [ ] telemetry links + smoke job stub
- [ ] append-on-merge opt-in
- [ ] post-release verification block

alex: pinging @release-bot and @oncall for awareness.

deploy-bot: ack — created ticket RF-3421 (runbook-snippet-generator) and posted demo in #release-ops.

maria: sweet. see you at the sync. :sparkles:
